commonFoundations.summary: Ordered, function-free transforms, top-level and layer pipelines, deterministic row lineage, parameters, seed and aggregation counts are supported; named sources, branches and a reusable DAG remain planned.

A closed portable encoding map, conditional mark channels, 17 positional/categorical/probability/temporal scale types, four color scale types and compatible primary x/y shared-domain resolve for Canvas unit views are supported; geographic/trading channels, shared multi-view axes and shared legends/colorbars remain planned.

A closed immutable v1 store, union/intersection semantics, point/interval/rectangle/axis/lasso state, Canvas pointer/touch gestures, scale-registry pixel/domain round-trip and continuous Cartesian domain zoom/pan are supported. Categorical geometry/navigation, spatial selection, keyboard-authored geometry, linked multi-view stores and selection-driven data transforms remain planned.

Legacy flat layers and the closed layer/facet/repeat/hconcat/vconcat/concat/inset Canvas composition grammar are supported with deterministic bounded layout, scoped semantic/lineage identities, independent child axes/legends and compatible primary x/y shared-domain resolve. Shared multi-view axes/legends/colorbars, linked view stores, facet pagination/virtualization, per-view interaction, streaming composition and Spatial/WebGL composition remain planned.

All Canvas families compile a bounded semantic index with lineage, Canvas Chart exposes a native table mirror, roving keyboard traversal, focus, tooltip and selection synchronization, and composed Canvas views carry deterministic scoped semantic, hit-target and lineage identities; equivalent native GPU traversal and linked multi-view focus stores remain planned.
Callout collision placement and connectors are supported; reusable mark labels, editing handles, snapping and undo/redo remain planned.

Typed column input, legacy copy-compatible appendData, deterministic stable-key append/upsert/replaceLast, bounded count/event-time retention, monotonic watermarks with explicit late-data policy, reject-only bounded queues/replay, and an opt-in transferable typed-column TransformSpec worker adapter are supported. Ring-buffer storage, incremental transform recomputation, worker-owned chart rendering, Arrow/WASM, RAF coalescing, pause/follow-live, lazy history and cancellation remain planned.

principles: Theme controls visual tokens and defaults, never family semantics or renderer availability.
Capability profiles describe renderer, interaction, accessibility and data behavior.
Family modes and recipes own data meaning, transforms and layout.
Aliases converge on one canonical implementation and never create a second renderer path.
Unavailable capabilities produce an explicit error, warning or documented fallback instead of a silent semantic downgrade.
A planned or research contract is never described as current runtime support.
